_comment: Requirements matrix: one row per requirement, its source, and how closeout.py checks it. Category separates hard production requirements from style objectives from bookkeeping, so a candidate can fail production yet still succeed as a style reference. This is DATA, not code -- edit rows to match a job; closeout.py reads it. Check types closeout.py understands: layer_a_passed, layer_b_passed, back_half_passed, tac_exact, no_continuous_tone, rendered_colors_le (value N), node_max_le (value N), vtracer_only, unique, visual_review_present, human_decision_present.

requirements.requirement: source remains recognizable in the trace
no embedded raster or source-level violation in final SVG
rendered colour count within the contract budget
no continuous tone (flat spot inks only)
candidate preserves the intended engraving/style character
TAC is exact before production approval
trace was produced by VTracer only (no LLM-generated SVG)
candidate is not a SHA duplicate of another candidate
